**EL-RSP-P1 DriverCan0 lighting input cycle**

DriverCan0 shall carry HazardLightButton, TurnStalk and LightStalk every 50 ms, and its load shall let each of these frames be sent within its cycle.

description: Platform part of EL-RSP-1.1 (SCCM_Lighting_IndicatorResponseTime). CommunicateAllocation_DriverCan0 places the TurnSignal, HazardLightButton, LightMode and HighBeam assemblies of ExteriorLightingDesign on DriverCan0, so the bus delay of EL-RSP-1.1 is this bus's to deliver.
Evidence: GenMsgCycleTime 50 ms of frames 100, 101 and 103 in driver_can.dbc; bus load in Bus_Load_Analysis.md.
